page.layout: One printed page of text in a single column, with a decorative fleuron border at the top; marginal note signs (numerals 1, 2, 3 and a mark) in the right margin; a partial page of another book at the left edge (show-through/neighbouring page, not transcribed); a catchword-like signature mark "I" at the bottom left and the word "poris" at the bottom right of the text block.

main_text.l: constare Eucharistiam duabus rebus: terrenâ, & cœlesti.
Itaque sentimus & docemus, cum pane & vino verè & substantialiter
substantia, & figura, & specie, & cerni ac tangi
possunt, sicut antea, Theodor. dial. 2. qui inscribitur Inconfus.
appellavit corpus, & id, quod mixtum est,
est scopus iis, qui Sacramentis initiati
quæ cernuntur, sed per nominum permutation-
em credere ei, quæ ex gratia facta est,
vitem nominavit, is visibilia symbola cor-

page.notes: Marginal signs 1, 2, 3 in the right margin are reference numerals without printed note text. The left edge shows a partial page of another book (show-through/neighbouring page), not transcribed. Several words in the text are blurred and may be misread, e.g. "Onfitemur", "adesse", "possunt". The bottom "I" is a signature mark; "poris" is the catchword.
